question: Estimate the adoption of vernacular content apps (ShareChat, Moj, Josh, Roposo, Chingari) in India by 2028.
idealClarificationQuestions: Active monthly users on vernacular short-video / social apps? Yes.
Counted across apps with overlap (most users on multiple)? Net unique users.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total Indian short-video users → Hindi/regional preference subset → vernacular app adoption.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian short-video app users (Instagram Reels + YouTube Shorts + vernacular apps): ~400M MAU.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Currently on dedicated vernacular apps (ShareChat, Moj, Josh): ~150-180M MAU (significant but losing share to Reels/Shorts since 2022).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Note: ShareChat saw decline post-2022; Moj, Josh stabilized lower.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: These questions test operations and scale thinking: fleet sizes, data center capacity, support headcount, server load. Translate user-side demand into the supply-side resources required. Most go bottom-up (load per unit × units needed) and cross-check with operator disclosures.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, primarily vernacular content consumers
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~250M (Reels and Shorts also have Indic content).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Currently on dedicated vernacular apps (ShareChat, Moj, Josh)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~150-180M MAU (significant but losing share to Reels/Shorts since 2022).
vernacular dedicated apps MAU likely flat to declining as Reels/Shorts continue dominating; ~140-160M.
ShareChat saw decline post-2022; Moj, Josh stabilized lower.

calculationFlow: Indian short-video app users (Instagram Reels + YouTube Shorts + vernacular apps): ~400M MAU.
